# QualFM

> QualFM Ltd is a facilities management and maintenance company operating
> across Ireland, founded by Richard Seaver (25 years' sector experience)
> in February 2025. Services span planned preventive maintenance, electrical
> and mechanical works, fitout projects, soft services, and compliance
> auditing, for commercial, pharmaceutical and healthcare clients.

QualFM is based in Portrane, Co. Dublin, Ireland, and serves clients
nationwide. Contact: service@qualfm.ie, +353 86 821 6215.
